title: KwanTube v3.5.1: reproducible open-system and convergence-validation framework for tubulin quantum dynamics
description: KwanTube is a fully reproducible computational framework for the study of quantum dynamics and decoherence in microtubule-inspired open quantum systems. It provides the full numerical stack (HEOM, Redfield, Bayesian hierarchy, Sobol sensitivity, SBC) required to reproduce all claims in the associated manuscript (PRX Life / bioRxiv). Architecture v3.5.1 introduces a hierarchical output directory structure and full SHA-256 integrity ledger.
